features.feature: Rectangular mattress with rounded corners and a low, even profile.
Light grey top with fine, closely spaced linear texture and a broad dark charcoal zigzag motif running lengthwise.
Dark charcoal textured fabric side wall.
Bright orange piping outlines the top edge and runs along the lower edge of the side wall.
Small two-tone “sleepyhead original” logo, with orange “sleepyhead” and white “original.”
Exploded view shows three foam slabs: light grey above orange above pink, over a dark cover base.
